_about: Cells where the cached value was written by LibreOffice and LibreOffice is known to differ from Microsoft Excel. LibreOffice has no true/false cell type (TRUE is the number 1 shown as TRUE), so it counts TRUE inside ranges, and it rejects text typed directly into SUM. These entries apply ONLY while the file's cached values come from LibreOffice; once the file is re-saved in Excel, Excel's own cached values are checked instead. The 'excel' value is what Excel's documented rules give.

Funcs!F1.rule: SUM ignores logical values (A4 = TRUE) inside a range: 1 + 2 + 5.5

Funcs!F2.rule: SUM counts numbers, TRUE and number-text typed directly as arguments: 1 + 2 + 1

Funcs!F3.rule: AVERAGE ignores logical values and text inside a range: (1 + 2 + 5.5) / 3

Funcs!F16.rule: NPV ignores logical values inside a range, so there are 3 cash flows (1, 2, 5.5), not 4

Funcs!F27.rule: COUNT does not count logical values inside a range
